rulings.why: Fly Speed from an activated tattoo reaches nothing; stances already carry speeds:{fly:...} (wings-of-air), so a toggle is deliverable.
Resistance 10 to all damage is a real numeric defense and no field or registry carries it.
stonestrike-stance exists in core.actions but not in core.stances (129 entries incl. tenacious-stance), so the dedication delivers nothing.
grantsLanguages IS read for feats (build.ts:3026) and the record has none; apply as ["petran"] - core.languages has no "terran" id.
The +2 ancestry HP is real and maxHpBonus exists only on FEATS ({flat}/{perLevel}/{perArchetypeFeat}); no heritage carries it.
A wielded staff gaining agile + d6 (or parry/reach/trip) changes Strike numbers and no field modifies an already-owned weapon.
The one-handed d4 form does not exist: core.items[bladed-scarf] is hands:2, damage d6. grantedStrikes is the right lane (use die:"d4", not "1d4").
Armor specialization is implemented nowhere in src (grepped src/rules + src/sheet); the resistance the rules grant never appears.
The +2 circumstance is on the character’s OWN Athletics check; sibling Tenacious-Stance feats are all in situationalBonuses.
heldSpells is a shipped item lane (620 items carry it, e.g. sun-wheel {"0":["shield"]}) and this wayfinder has none, so the Heal is uncastable.
294 feats carry innateSpells; this one has only limitedUses, so Illusory Disguise never reaches the Spells page.
Activated fly Speed (25 ft or land Speed, whichever is slower) reaches no field; counters/frequency only track the cadence.
Activated fly Speed reaches no field; frequency only tracks once/day.
Two bonus Performance skill feats reach nothing. FEAT_PICK_GRANTS (featPickGrants.ts) is the real lane - note the fix’s "featFilter" key does not exist on EffectChoice.
Daily trained-skill pick reaches nothing and the choice.daily lane exists. Encode as choice.daily, not trainedSkillChoice:"any" (that field is background-only and takes an array).
CLASS_RESOURCES has versatile-vials only under alchemist; the investigator has only devise-stratagem, so the +1/2/3 has nothing to modify.
ALREADY MODELLED: classes.investigator.subclass.options[alchemical-sciences-methodology].grants.skills=["crafting"] already trains Crafting.
A per-item proficiency step-up from a rune has no lane; weaponFamiliarity is feat-keyed and category-wide.
Same as ageless-spirit: no choice on the record. Encode via choice.daily, not trainedSkillChoice:"any".
situationalBonuses covers the +1s but nothing trains Deception; zero heritages carry any skill-training field and build.ts reads trainedSkill only from backgrounds.
FeatGrant.armor only ever RAISES a flat rank and has no "only where already trained" form, so needsEngineWork is right; no featGrantsAuto/featGrantsLane entry exists.
The armor check penalty IS modelled (derive.ts:402) and nothing reduces it for Stealth; the situational lane already stores signed adjustments.
Recurring 1d6 persistent bleed on knife Strikes against off-guard targets; conditional, so situational is the right lane, and the record carries nothing.

ALREADY MODELLED: classes.rogue.subclass.options[avenger] carries grants.skills=[intimidation,religion], grants.armor=[medium], keyAbilityOptions and requiresDeity; the proposed classArchetype block restates data that already ships.
No featGrantsAuto entry (only azarketi-weapon-familiarity). The fix is over-cautious: weaponFamiliarity.mirrorBestCategory DOES follow the class rank, so this is a data entry, not engine work.
Backgrounds are exactly where trainedSkillChoice/trainedLoreChoice/grantedFeatId work (421/500 carry trainedSkill); this one has only abilityBoosts.

ALREADY MODELLED: classes.cleric.subclass.options[battle-creed] carries slotProgression:"two-rank", suppressedFeatures:[resolute-faith,miraculous-spell] and grantedFeats; the judge asserted none of it reaches the sheet and that no lane can replace a spells-per-day table.
ALREADY MODELLED: classes.swashbuckler.subclass.options[battledancer].grants.skills=["performance"] trains it; the claim that swashbuckler has no style-skill lane is false.
ALREADY MODELLED: classes.swashbuckler.subclass.options[braggart].grants.skills=["intimidation"] already trains Intimidation.
critSpec.ts has a brawling entry but the feat carries no critSpec/critSpecWeapons, so the monk never sees it; both fields are real (student-of-the-staff precedent).
Well-formed choice.daily; the lane is live (quick-study, environmental-adaptability) and the record has only limitedUses.
The full description confirms "trained in arcane spell attack rolls and spell DCs... spellcasting ability is Intelligence"; spellcastingGrant is a shipped Feat field and is absent here.
Swim Speed from a talisman reaches nothing; mode modifiers are numeric only (targets: save/skill/attack/perception/damage/ac/all-checks), which the fix honestly flags.
Same confirmed gap at full land Speed; a distinct priced item, not an umbrella record.
Absent from featGrantsAuto; dwarf advanced weapons (dwarven war axe, scattergun, dorn dergar) and limited-expertise classes make mirrorBestCategory a real delta.
47 backgrounds carry trainedLoreChoice:true; this one has abilityBoosts + innateSpells and no lore field at all.
Absent from featGrantsAuto; real for any class whose best category outruns martial (an elf wizard gets expert elven weapons while martial stays trained).
ALREADY MODELLED: the subclass option carries skillChoice=["arcana","crafting","occultism","society"] - literally the proposed fix; grants is null BECAUSE the pick lives in skillChoice.
Absent from featGrantsAuto; gnome flickmace and switchscythe are advanced, so the mirror is a real delta.
Absent from featGrantsAuto (only hobgoblin- is present); explosive dogslicer and flingflenser are advanced.
Absent from featGrantsAuto; real for limited-expertise classes even though every halfling weapon is simple/martial.
Real daily expert/master skill grant with nothing on the record; choice.daily is the right lane, but use kind:"array" - kind:"open" with no `from` is dropped by dailyChoicesFor.

PREMISE FALSE: esoteric-polymath’s daily choice is kind:"text" (free-typed spell name; its own note says the occult book is not modelled), so there is no tradition filter to widen and the player can already record a cross-tradition pick.
situationalBonuses covers Track animals and featFeatGrants the feat, but nothing trains Survival; the record’s dataWarning is about the missing feat id, not this.
A full alternate form (AC 18+level, fly 30, weapon proficiency, action lockout) with no stance/mode entry, while 20+ form:true stances already ship.
COMPANION_MODS carries maturityFloor + skillGrants for its siblings (specialized-companion-animal-trainer, chorus-companion) and has no entry for this Animal Trainer rung.
bonusLanguageSlots (build.ts:824) is max(0,Int mod) + ancestry.languages.additional and never reads feats; grantsLanguages is documented as fixed grants only.
Absent from featGrantsAuto; butchering axe, barricade buster and orc necksplitter are advanced. Re-derive the weapon ids from core.items before applying.
The record’s choice values are exactly fortitude/reflex/will and FeatGrant.choiceGrants keys verbatim on them, so the fix is well-formed and nothing applies the pick today.
+2/+4/+6 fire on the character’s own melee Strikes; "damage" is a live mode modifier target and no mode/stance entry exists.
Item-borne proficiency RANK has no lane - ItemPassiveEffects.skills is numeric and loreChoices is heritage-only; the ranks land on the player’s own sheet.
Crafting + Cooking Lore reach nothing; build.ts:2273 iterates c.feats so heritage ids never hit FEAT_GRANTS, and the record’s dataWarning confirms the grant was authored but unreachable.
Level-15 choose-one-of-N with concrete resistances and no effectChoices; EffectGrant.resistances is exactly the right shape and classFeatures already carry effectChoices.
runelord-dedication ships with NO classArchetype while war-mage-, vindicator- and warrior-of-legend-dedication all carry one; the polearm/spear training and Thassilonian are lost.
Society training reaches nothing - same heritage/FEAT_GRANTS reach problem, confirmed by the record’s dataWarning.
Critical-failure-to-failure on the player’s own Nature check; situationalBonuses stores exactly this form and the item has only `uses`.
advancement.ts covers the class DC only; the range-increment waiver has an exact precedent at situationalBonuses.ts:2188 (masterful-hunter) and no entry here.
Confirmed: SNARE_CRAFTING_SOURCES = {snare-crafting, snarecrafter-dedication, snare-expert, snare-setter}; this feat is absent, so the formula book and prepared snares are zero.
DUPLICATE: the untagged AoN twin of specialized-companion-animal-trainer, which COMPANION_MODS:172 already covers with the identical entry - a dedup/suppression issue, not a mechanics gap.
Master Performance in place of Athletics/Acrobatics is exactly COMPANION_MODS.skillGrants (chorus-companion, fell-rider precedent) and there is no entry.

FIX WOULD BE WRONG: master Stealth applies only to a specialized AMBUSHER but companionGrants.skillGrants is unconditional, so the entry would hand every companion a rank the rules do not grant; the Camouflage half is a terrain permission, not a number.
choice + counters + the +3 status are present, but the headline expert/master/legendary step-up has no item-borne rank lane.
Degree-of-success improvement on the player’s own Survival check; sibling navigators-feather is at situationalBonuses.ts:1748 and this item has only `uses`.
loreChoices IS read for heritages (build.ts:1315) and this record has only effectChoices, so the Lore the existing situational entry points at is never trained.
Critical-failure-to-failure across trained Lores; the lore:* target shape already exists (silvertongue-mutagen) and there is no entry.
The one-rank-better Perception for magical traps has precedent at memory-of-skill:2564 / pilferers-gloves:2583 and no entry here.
Not in FEAT_GRANTS. The crit-spec half is the real gap (critSpec + critSpecWeapons.bases); the weaponFamiliarity half is near-inert since all four weapons are simple/martial.
The choice is recorded but EffectGrant has no hp / save-rank / armor-rank track, so none of +4 HP, expert Fortitude or trained medium armor lands.
"Trained in all simple and martial weapons" reaches nothing; heritage ids are never looked up in FEAT_GRANTS and the record’s dataWarning confirms it.
Re-keying a weapon’s GROUP per inventory item drives both the group-proficiency lookup and critSpec.ts and has no lane; modes are numeric only.
situationalBonuses covers the Seek bonus but nothing trains Crafting - same heritage/FEAT_GRANTS reach problem, confirmed by the dataWarning.
situationalBonuses + featFeatGrants cover the other halves; nothing trains Acrobatics, and no heritage carries any skill-training field.
